summary: CKD iteration 2 E2E test. BACKEND: 34/34 pytest regression cases pass (auth, profile, campaigns, issues, notifications, leaderboard, flags, admin, media-upload auth+content-type guards). FRONTEND (390x844 mobile viewport): all 6 features verified except a UX gap in membership-card share. BUG-2 (submit toast) ✅ — empty submit shows field-specific Hindi toast 'शीर्षक भरें', then 'समस्या का विवरण भरें', 'कोई एक श्रेणी चुनें', 'राज्य चुनें' progressively, replacing the old silent Alert.alert. BUG-1 (Cloudinary upload Blob conversion in /app/frontend/src/api.ts) — code path is correctly implemented (Platform.OS==='web' branch builds File from fetch(uri)→blob and FormData); backend tests confirm endpoint accepts multipart and rejects non-image; programmatic upload from browser context could not be triggered cleanly via Playwright because expo-image-picker dynamically creates+removes the <input type=file> per call, so the FIX itself is verified by code review + backend behaviour rather than a full browser click-through. FEAT-3 admin panel loads at /admin with dashboard counts (9 सदस्य, 5 अभियान, 1/1/3 issues by status), tabs visible including अभियान. FEAT-4 State→City cascade ✅ — राज्य dropdown opens with searchbox + 28+ states, selecting दिल्ली populates city options, इलाक़ा is a free TextInput. FEAT-5 membership card ✅ renders on Profile with purple gradient + golden border, logo, initials avatar, name 'CKD एडमिन', member ID 'CKD-51C9ACE4', city, join date '27 मई 2026', tagline 'युवा जागे, देश बदले', और 56 क्रांति अंक. Share button present and tappable — HOWEVER tapping it produces an ERROR toast 'कार्ड साझा नहीं हो सका' on web preview because captureRef (view-shot html2canvas) throws and the catch returns ok:false WITHOUT attempting any fallback (text share / web-share / download). FEAT-6 share-campaigns ✅ — 5 'शेयर' icon buttons rendered on /(tabs)/campaigns list cards alongside 'विस्तार'. REGRESSION: login (9999999999 + 123456), 5-tab nav, admin link all functional. Console deprecation warnings persist (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, expo-image-picker MediaTypeOptions).

ui_bugs.issue: On web preview captureRef throws (html2canvas backend unreliable). The outer try/catch returns {ok:false, mode:'error'} so the Profile screen shows red toast 'कार्ड साझा नहीं हो सका'. Per the spec 'any success is acceptable (image/download/web-share)' — currently NONE of the three fallbacks fire because the failure happens before reaching the dataURL branch. Recommend wrapping captureRef in its own try/catch and on failure attempt navigator.share({title,text,url}) or copy-link-to-clipboard so the user gets a successful share path instead of an error.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions have been deprecated. Use ImagePicker.MediaType or an array of ImagePicker.MediaType instead.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/report.tsx:35 (and any other launchImageLibraryAsync calls).
Console deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. (carried over from iteration 1).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' (carried over from iteration 1; likely from a dependency).

action_items: Improve shareMembershipCard web fallback: when captureRef fails on web, attempt navigator.share({title,text}) or Clipboard.setStringAsync(caption+link) instead of returning {ok:false,mode:'error'}. Currently the only feedback to the user on web is a red error toast.

Migrate ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images / .Videos to ImagePicker.MediaType.Images / .Videos (or arrays) in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/report.tsx and anywhere else in the codebase to silence the SDK deprecation warning.
(Low) Audit remaining shadow* and props.pointerEvents usages flagged in iteration 1; still present.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts upload() correctly distinguishes web vs native: on web converts URI→Blob via fetch(uri) and wraps in File before FormData append — this is the correct fix for the 422 issue on Expo web.
Toast.tsx is platform-agnostic (Animated.View overlay), correctly placed above content with zIndex 9999 and 4.5s auto-dismiss for errors — good replacement for Alert.alert.
LocationPicker resets city when state changes (line 65 of LocationPicker.tsx) — cascade behaviour correct. City dropdown disabled until state picked (line 89).
MembershipCard uses ref forwarding + collapsable=false to make it captureable by react-native-view-shot — correct setup.

shareMembershipCard error path on web is over-eager: the outer try/catch swallows the captureRef failure WITHOUT trying navigator.share text fallback. Move captureRef into an inner try and continue to navigator.share text on failure.
server.py still 988 lines (>700 threshold) — flagged previously, not iteration-2 scope.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (5/6 features fully working; membership-card share emits error toast on web preview instead of using a text/web-share fallback)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created in this iteration. Existing seeded admin (9999999999), 5 sample members and 5 campaigns (3 original + 2 TEST_अभियान from prior pytest runs) verified present via admin dashboard counts (9 members, 5 campaigns).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_ckd_api.py — all 34 pass in ~3.3s. Onboarding has 3 slides; use [data-testid='onboarding-skip'] to jump to login. Login testIDs: login-mobile-input, login-send-otp-btn, login-otp-input, login-verify-otp-btn (NOTE: README/iter1 mentioned login-send-otp / login-verify-otp without -btn suffix — actual code uses -btn). Admin city is 'दिल्ली' so report.tsx pre-fills city from user — when testing the cascade with state=दिल्ली, the cities under दिल्ली in /app/frontend/src/data/locations.ts include 'दिल्ली' itself, NOT 'नई दिल्ली'. expo-image-picker on web dynamically creates and removes input[type=file] elements, making programmatic file injection in Playwright unreliable; prefer testing api.upload at the HTTP layer directly with a proper Bearer token (token is stored via the storage util, key may differ between web/native).
rca_of_issue: Card-share error toast RCA: in /app/frontend/src/utils/share.ts shareMembershipCard, the Platform.OS==='web' branch wraps the entire flow (captureRef + dataURL fetch + Web Share + download fallback) in a single try/catch. captureRef on web uses html2canvas which is known to throw on cross-origin images / LinearGradient. When it throws, control jumps to the outer catch which returns {ok:false, mode:'error'}, never reaching the document.createElement('a') download fallback or attempting a text-only navigator.share. Mitigation: split into two try blocks — first try captureRef, on failure fall through to navigator.share({title,text,url}) → on failure copy caption to clipboard and toast success ('कैप्शन कॉपी हो गया').
